decisions.reason: The area elastic sports floor builds on the firm's in-house wood-surface know-how and costs little to keep listed, but there is no evidence after 2019 to resolve its value, so the option stays open.
The mobile arena floor is a niche, project-driven option outside the residential style focus, yet without negative evidence it is cheap enough to retain while demand stays uncertain.
This second mobile arena system overlaps with Product B, which makes it the likelier candidate for consolidation, but nothing yet shows it has failed, so it is kept for now.
The chevron parquet is the flagship and fits the firm's trend-led, natural-aesthetic direction, so it warrants further commitment rather than abandonment.
The squash court finish is a small niche surface option with low upkeep that complements the sports range, so keeping it open is sensible.
The oak skirting is a low-cost accessory that supports the sports floor systems, so it has little reason to be dropped while those systems remain.
